body:
Ive been interested in legals recentlyafter being introduced to, and thoroughly enjoying mephedrone via this route, it was decided by the group experimental collective to acquire a new legal substance to play with
And so we enter the GBL phase. I like legals in that they are cheap, easy to obtain and very pure. GBL is a prodrug of GHB, which is a class C drug here in the UK. GBL
kicks in quicker, lasts longer, and is more potent weight for weight. It was sold online as car alloy cleaner (mephedrone as plant food).
The GBL bottle was supplied with a small pipette, and 1.5ml is added to a tiny glass of wine or orange juice and either sipped or drank quickly (due to the foul taste of GBL, I prefer to down mine).
The effects are very very nice indeed. Very similar to alcohol, but I think it surpasses it greatly (apart from the taste!). Much more buzzy in the head and body, and there is a noticeable empathic quality to it that far surpasses alcohol. I feel a strong desire to talk and joke, often loudly, and I feel very warm and content. I also tend to drink less when Ive had GBL. I also feel quite stimulated, despite this being a powerful sedative supposedly. Dancing and walking is fun, and I am tactile and generally feel well disposed towards anyone else around, and enjoy conversation. It is a very powerful intoxication, yet at the same time, very smooth and gentle.
GBL is being made illegal in the UK
